propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use argparse.HelpFormatter instead of RebarHelpFormatter, creating width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and py3.13 staleness risk for help artifacts.

py3.13 argparse option rendering (short+long metavar and subparser usage wrapping) diverges from py3.11/py3.12, causing gen_cli_help.py --check to fail on py3.13 CI if factories lack RebarHelpFormatter's version-pinned overrides.

The four factories must be switched to RebarHelpFormatter and help artifacts regenerated to canonical width-80 form to eliminate the latent help-staleness trap that S2d resolved for bridge but left open for metrics/audit/bridge-fsck/bridge-probe.
A contract test must enforce that all help-backed (rendered, non-intercept) route parser factories use a formatter subclassing RebarHelpFormatter, preventing reintroduction of the regression.
